headline: Four more games can play themselves — batch 8 sits merge-ready behind the freeze
lede: BeeZee, Tidy Bot, Pick Rush and Garden Guard each got a Y key that seats the very autopilot their attract demo flies and their own harness wins with — takeover, re-seat and phone pill all proven in a 404-assertion watchcheck sweep. The shelf now guides 41 of 80 titles. Nightly #47 came back red on a single archery gate and the diagnosis (the shot lands, the new quiver economy just hides it) is handed to QA with the exact gate fix.

notes.text: WATCH batch 8 (PR #1738): Y seats autopilot(gs)/autoStep(gs) in BeeZee, Tidy Bot, Pick Rush (seat 1 only — your partner keeps theirs) and Garden Guard; 41/80 titles now advertise the guide.

Mutant run caught two traps: Vite served stale transforms after out-of-band writes (restart + served-marker check now law), and an idle BeeZee bee turns out to drift on wind and pollinate on contact — so the pilot signal was rebuilt as a consumed-thrust counter that no idle run can produce.

Nightly #47 red localized to one gate: archeryplay's scalar quiver signal is stale against #1685's pullable-scavenge economy — the arrow IS loosed. Diagnosis + id-set gate fix posted on #1736; carriers #46-green/#47-red pinned the culprit commit without reading a log.
